kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننتقم (form VIII)
# نَنْتَقِمُ (nantaqimu) /nan.ta.qi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَمَ (intaqama)
# نَنْتَقِمَ (nantaqima) /nan.ta.qi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَمَ (intaqama)
# نَنْتَقِمْ (nantaqim) /nan.ta.qim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْتَقَمَ (intaqama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
